name: Carmilla de Alhazred XIII
original_name: キャルミラ・ド・アルハザード十三世
source:
The leader of the Nation of Everlasting Night Alhazred, and a Miko of the Divine Beast. A true Ancestor and a Vampire, she is not only well loved by her citizens for her natural charisma, but also for her natural aptitude for magic and deep wealth of knowledge. No matter the adversity she faces, she never complains and always remains calm and takes it all with the grace and elegance you would expect from Nobility.

[From the [url=https://ninetail.info/CF/VenusBloodGAIA_International/en18_character.html]official website[/url]]
